import numpy as np
def _thomas(a,b,c,d):
    n=len(d); cp=np.zeros(n); dp=np.zeros(n)
    cp[0]=c[0]/b[0]; dp[0]=d[0]/b[0]
    for i in range(1,n):
        m=b[i]-a[i]*cp[i-1]
        cp[i]=c[i]/m
        dp[i]=(d[i]-a[i]*dp[i-1])/m
    x=np.zeros(n); x[-1]=dp[-1]
    for i in range(n-2,-1,-1): x[i]=dp[i]-cp[i]*x[i+1]
    return x

def crank_nicolson_diffusion(u0,D,dx,dt,steps,bc):
    u=np.array(u0,dtype=np.float64).copy()
    n=len(u); r=D*dt/(dx*dx)/2.0
    a=np.full(n,-r); b=np.full(n,1+2*r); c=np.full(n,-r)
    if bc=='dirichlet':
        b[0]=1.0; c[0]=0.0; a[-1]=0.0; b[-1]=1.0
    else:
        c[0]=-2*r; a[-1]=-2*r
    for _ in range(int(steps)):
        rhs=np.empty(n)
        if bc=='dirichlet':
            rhs[1:-1]=u[1:-1]+r*(u[2:]-2*u[1:-1]+u[:-2])
            rhs[0]=u[0]; rhs[-1]=u[-1]
        else:
            rhs[1:-1]=u[1:-1]+r*(u[2:]-2*u[1:-1]+u[:-2])
            rhs[0]=u[0]+r*(2*u[1]-2*u[0])
            rhs[-1]=u[-1]+r*(2*u[-2]-2*u[-1])
        u=_thomas(a,b,c,rhs)
    return u
```'''
